purpose: Single-card TileLang-MUSA global-memory, cache-working-set, stride/alignment and shared-memory calibration.
parameter_policy: Only logical-payload effective rates are reported. They are conditional TileLang-MUSA path measurements, not physical DDR or cache specifications.

cache_conclusion.reason: fixed-grid 32 MiB is not repeatable; 4 KiB-64 MiB dependent pointer chasing is flat; post-256 MiB/1 GiB flush comparisons show no reproducible isolated cliff.

shared_conclusion.reason: repeated-read rate is baseline-subtracted and compiler emits a parallel-loop race warning despite numerical correctness; no bank mapping conclusion is allowed.

next_phase: P4 occupancy, pipeline and wave calibration.
